item.title: PQ wins Chicoutimi byelection as CAQ vote collapses
item.description: Voters in the riding of Chicoutimi went to the polls Monday to replace former CAQ MNA Andrée Laforest. The PQ bagged its fourth byelection win since 2023.

item.title: Quebec Olympians arrive at Trudeau airport wearing their medals and happy to be home
